buyNFT().details: Mints a new NFT to the caller after receiving payment in PlatformCredits. Requires prior approval of PlatformCredits for this contract.

buyNFTWithPermit(uint256,uint8,bytes32,b.details: Mints a new NFT using PlatformCredits, leveraging ERC2612 permit. Allows purchase without a prior separate 'approve' transaction.

params.r: The r value of the permit signature.
params.s: The s value of the permit signature.
params.v: The recovery byte of the permit signature.

buyNFTWithSignatureAndPermit(address,uin.details: Mints a new NFT to a user, authorized by the user's EIP-712 signature for the action and an ERC2612 permit signature for the PlatformCredits. This allows a third-party relayer (msg.sender) to submit the transaction.

params.actionR: The r value of the EIP-712 action signature.
params.actionS: The s value of the EIP-712 action signature.
params.actionV: The recovery byte of the EIP-712 action signature.
params.permitDeadline: The deadline for the ERC2612 permit.
params.permitR: The r value of the permit signature.
params.permitS: The s value of the permit signature.
params.permitV: The recovery byte of the permit signature.
params.user: The address of the user who is buying the NFT and providing signatures.

returns._0: The ID of the minted token.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
